definitions.explanation: The eighth sign of the Western zodiac, covering people born roughly October 24 to November 22. Also the constellation Scorpius. Used in horoscopes and casual talk about star signs; often written with the kana さそり{座|ざ}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{蠍座|さそりざ}だ。
{蠍座|さそりざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{情熱的|じょうねつてき}→情熱的：16048_jounetsuteki⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Scorpio people are said to be passionate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{占|うらな}い→占い：18736_uranai⟧で、⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蠍座|さそりざ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{勝負|しょうぶ}→勝負：01437_shoubu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The horoscope said this month is a strong period for Scorpio in competitions.

notes:
The zodiac sign Scorpio, for people born from late October to late November. Because {蠍|さそり} is an uncommon kanji, the kana spelling さそり⟦{座|ざ}→座：28170_za⟧ is very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蠍座|さそりざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person born under Scorpio
- {蠍座|さそりざ}⟦{生|う}まれ→生まれ：01867_umare⟧: born a Scorpio
- {蠍座|さそりざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運勢|うんせい}→運勢：15761_unsei⟧: the Scorpio horoscope

USAGE:
Star signs are common small-talk in Japan and appear in magazine and morning-TV horoscope segments (⟦{星占|ほしうらな}い→星占い：18861_hoshiuranai⟧).
